title: Fix POSIX isolated-module capture drain after leader exit
body:
A successful isolated unittest can finish while its ordinary POSIX child/grandchild still holds the runner's capture pipes. Previously, `communicate` waited for pipe EOF before `finally` could clean that same process group: the default unlimited invocation waited indefinitely, and a finite budget converted the already-completed `OK` module to timeout 124. A real macOS fixture reproduced the difference by changing only descendant stdout/stderr inheritance (redirected: success in 0.067 s; inherited: rejected at the 3 s deadline).

This repair recognizes an exited POSIX leader before the deadline, invokes the existing owned-group cleanup, then drains the original captured buffers with a bounded two-second cleanup wait. Actual exit status and the successful-unittest completion receipt remain required. Elapsed deadlines and cancellation retain priority; a newly observed late exit cannot become success.

This deliberately supersedes the old `test_completed_receipt_with_open_child_pipe_still_times_out` expectation. Completed modules now have the same cleanup policy whether ordinary descendants close their pipes or inherit them, matching #2906's closed-pipe POSIX case and #4683's Windows owned-job lifecycle. Proof-relevant subprocesses must still be joined by their tests and propagate their failures. Deliberately detached descendants are outside the owned-process-group contract; cleanup/drain failure never reports PASS. No frozen scientific source, selected frontier, Windows implementation or acceptance pin changes.

Validation on macOS 27.0 arm64 / CPython 3.12.2:

- Focused inherited `test_isolated_test_*.py`: 50 cases, 27 pass / 23 platform skips, 11.697 s at the follow-up. Together with the ten new cases: 60 total, 37 pass / 23 skips.
- The final CI-discoverable module passes ten new cases in normal and optimized modes. The initial nine-case body also passed through the actual isolated `run_modules` entry (8.499 s).
- Real child/grandchild readiness and native kqueue exit observations cover success with a queued module, failed unittest, zero exit without completion, joined work, exact 200 KB stdout / 100 KB binary stderr, live-leader timeout, SIGINT cancellation and omitted group cleanup. Two deterministic clock controls check deadline precedence, including a valid completion receipt with the exit poll itself crossing the deadline. The previous ordering reports code 0 in this controlled case; the follow-up correctly returns 124 by observing exit before reading the deadline clock. Linux uses retained pidfds but is unrun locally.
- Complete existing registered compatibility hooks `isolated-test-bytecode` and `isolated-descendant-bytecode` pass (6.313 s / 22.600 s), preserving their original source/cache differentials and controls.
- `git diff --check` passes; only the four scoped files change. Author and committer are JoyboyBrian.

Hosted CI for exact public head `8d00967e3942cfd85e19f30e72ea9f5e68bc8f7b` has completed with three successful checks and one inherited metadata failure. The [Ubuntu plan/onboarding job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39844507275/job/120054595042) actually ran all ten new `test_research_isolated_test_posix_pipes` cases and each passed, including Linux pidfd observation, timeout/cancellation, output preservation and both deadline controls (Ubuntu 24.04.5 / CPython 3.12.15; overall 356 tests, `OK (skipped=11)`, 132.207 s). Both selected bytecode compatibility package jobs also passed.

The [sole failing `isolated-runner-successor` job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39844507275/job/120056350452) stops before replay at `working source drift: certificates/selected-result.json`. This exact failure was independently reproduced with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/isolated-runner-successor --check-only` using the exact canonical base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43` checker, metadata and input files, with an isolated Git HEAD at that base. The unchanged package pin is `bb2eaa58647b353f88d0aec2eafb9d30df1be53589231b23e12ceef3e4bad129`; both base and PR head have selected-result SHA-256 `6fe0a099b89aa2aed796a13c3a21dafc63f3388ebf397464e44e0451893b9375`. The package directory and selected-result file are unchanged by this PR. Its runner pin `ef5035e6…` also already differs from base `c2ba0ce2…`. This historical admission obligation remains open; no frozen pin or acceptance list was refreshed, and CI is not fully green. No full repository, historical or mathematical suite was rerun.

Exact reproduction commands, base hashes, policy scope and open questions are in `docs/research/isolated-test-posix-pipes.md`. Base is canonical `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7.
